description: Format a non-negative integer number of seconds as a human-readable duration. 0 -> 'now'. Otherwise decompose greedily into years (365 days = 31536000 s), days (86400 s), hours (3600 s), minutes (60 s) and seconds (1 s); skip any unit whose count is zero. Each component reads '<count> <unit>' with the unit pluralized (trailing 's') when the count is not 1. Join the components with ', ' between all but the last and ' and ' before the last (e.g. '1 hour, 1 minute and 2 seconds'); a single component stands alone. Negative input raises ValueError; non-int input (including bool) raises TypeError. Pure and deterministic.
constraints: deterministic, pure, no I/O, no randomness, no global state
